owner: BE-P services/approval; BE-0 alone integrates parent reactor and trusted routes
authentication: ApprovalAccess adapter must authenticate TLS/service edge, browser session, CSRF/origin for writes, current tenant/actor and current object qualifications. No client identity/authority fields. Production default adapter rejects all calls with 503 APPROVAL_TRUST_NOT_CONFIGURED.

POST.Idempotency-Key: one canonical lowercase UUID, mandatory and exactly equal to body.operationId

inputRules.body: at most 65536 bytes including chunked body; unknown/duplicate JSON fields rejected
inputRules.operationId: canonical UUID, required; stable through unknown recovery; scoped by trusted tenant/actor and bound to action/target/complete parameters
inputRules.assignmentId: canonical lowercase UUID string; current acting engineer assignment, verified by trusted ticket adapter
inputRules.departmentId: positive BIGINT decimal string; current assignment department ID, not client authority
inputRules.warehouseId: positive signed-BIGINT decimal string, no leading zeros; existence/active/current tenant/warehouse scope checked by trusted stock adapter
inputRules.partId: positive signed-BIGINT decimal string, no leading zeros; actual part/warehouse relationship verified by trusted stock adapter
inputRules.previousApplicationId: optional UUID, only a WITHDRAWN or REJECTED application of same tenant/applicant/ticket; creates new id/revision and preserves old facts
inputRules.expectedVersion: nonnegative signed-BIGINT decimal STRING, no leading zeros except 0; required for decide/withdraw
inputRules.reason: APPROVE optional <=500; REJECT required 5..500; WITHDRAW optional <=500 Unicode code points

routes.result: ApplicationView; submission with previousApplicationId creates a new revision, never edits the prior application
current ApplicationView, current object authorization; GET writes no business/audit/outbox facts
original result for current tenant/actor and operation UUID after CURRENT object authorization; receipt snapshot can be older than current application: refresh detail separately
ApplicationView; current supervisor in source department and current object scope, not applicant; approval grants qualification only, never inventory execution
ApplicationView; current enabled applicant with current object scope; only PENDING/WAITING_CONFIGURATION, no rewrite of approved/rejected history

ApplicationView.decision: null or {operationId UUID,tenantId string,actorId string,expectedVersion decimal string,outcome APPROVE|REJECT,reason string}
ApplicationView.decidedAt: null or UTC ISO8601 with Z

revision.number: positive decimal string, distinct from optimistic version

ApplicationView.withdrawal: null or {operationId UUID,tenantId string,actorId string,expectedVersion decimal string,reason string}
ApplicationView.withdrawnAt: null or UTC ISO8601 with Z

errors.400: INVALID_REQUEST / INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY / INVALID_OBJECT_ID / INVALID_DEPARTMENT / INVALID_VERSION / INVALID_PURPOSE / INVALID_REASON / REASON_REQUIRED / other field errors
errors.401: SESSION_INVALID from future trusted adapter; no automatic retry
errors.403: NOT_AUTHORIZED; no replay using old permission
errors.404: TARGET_NOT_ACCESSIBLE or OPERATION_NOT_OBSERVED; original-operation 404 permits only explicit same UUID/same parameters retry after identity/context match, never a fresh UUID
errors.409: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT / VERSION_CONFLICT / ALREADY_DECIDED / APPLICATION_WITHDRAWN / NOT_WITHDRAWABLE / REVISION_SOURCE_REQUIRED / TICKET_NOT_APPROVABLE / other state conflicts
errors.503: DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE / OPERATION_RESULT_UNKNOWN / APPROVAL_TRUST_NOT_CONFIGURED; keep original UUID/parameters and query original operation, never declare success or start a new operation

errorShape.retryable: boolean (503 only signals uncertain/recoverable, not permission to blindly replay)

cache: Cache-Control:no-store for all successes and errors
atomicity: one approval local transaction: reservation of operation UUID + application/CAS or new immutable revision + original receipt + append audit + append immutable approval_outbox envelope; real MySQL behavior not yet accepted
outbox: approval_outbox uses events-v1 envelope with approval.submitted/approved/rejected/withdrawn and ticketId/requestId references. No delivery worker yet. BE-N generic event_outbox/event_delivery names differ; BE-0/N must wire a same-owner-transaction append/claim adapter before real notification acceptance. Do not publish via a separate notification DB transaction.
notImplemented: trusted approval service edge and current identity/ticket/stock adapters
multi-line part applications (this slice submits one line, not complete P03)
evidenceScope: pure domain tests, H2 JDBC transactions/concurrency/audit and outbox rollback, mock transaction failure ownership, Boot MockMvc strict wire/default failclosed. None replace MySQL/TLS/real account/browser/independent acceptance.

stockExecutionPolicy.next: Stock execution-api-v1.json; per-action ticket permit completion is not whole-parts cleanup
stockExecutionPolicy.legacy: Absent/null retains original request hash, old receipts and UNKNOWN policy; never defaults FREE
stockExecutionPolicy.currentRead: Current GET shows explicit mode to reviewer; original result is historical only
stockExecutionPolicy.persistence: V4 approval_execution_policy inserted with original submission transaction
